confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live Istanbul menus, bar lists or hotel rates. Restaurant anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation is lower confidence because July peak-season rates and Turkish lira price volatility vary widely. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from the beer anchor using typical local price ratios. FX is provisional: no rba.gov.au table was opened. The 15 October value comes from a search snippet attributed to the RBA exchange rates page, and it differs from third-party figures (0.6979 on 9 October, 0.6973 on 14 October). A 16 October item was ignored because it is after the generation date. Verify against RBA table F11 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Turkey is transcontinental and is placed in Middle East for this taxonomy. Istanbul is benchmarked against Eastern Mediterranean and Balkan tourist capitals: inexpensive and mid-range meals sit below Western European levels, and July hotel rates reflect peak tourist demand.
